newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil down on extended technical selling.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil down on extended technical selling.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Extended technical selling, due to a lack of positive factors, drove prices down and the support level below 1,180. Prices seen softer in week ahead, with a new and wider range of 1,150 to 1,200. SGS' full-June export data, scheduled for release on Monday, unlikely to move trade by staying within market expectations of 620,000 tonnes.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Interest confined to nearby months.

"Fundamentally, the (palm oil) market is very weak," said another dealer. "There are no external factors such as bean oil or anything supporting the market now and neither are the big boys like Pakistan, China or India coming in to buy."
Traders said the September contract was seen trading in a wider band of 1,150-1,200 ringgit next week.
"It'll be in this range unless something happens," said one dealer. "The picture doesn't look good."
Dealers said the next keenly-watched indicator in the market was the full-June export figure estimates from SGS (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd, expected on Monday.
"We don't expect any surprises with this as the market seems to be narrowly looking at around 620,000 tonnes," said one trader.
At the close, September futures was down 13 ringgit to 1,175 ($466).
On the physicals side, July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,215.50 ringgit against bids at 1,210 after trading from 1,212.50 to 1,215 and back to 1,212.50.
July (central) saw offers at 1,205, versus bids at 1,195 and trades at 1,205 and 1,200.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,215 against bids at 1,210. Aug (central) saw offers at 1,205 and bids at 1,190 after trading at 1,205 to 1,202.50 and 1,200.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $512.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug/Sept at $510, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $507.50.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $550 and Aug/Sept at $545 and Oct/Nov/Dec at 542.50. July was traded at $547.50.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $392.50 and Aug/Sept at $387.50. July/Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillates saw sellers at $292.50. -- K. Baranee Krishnaan (603- 275-6834) ($1-2.5150)
